ambusher.name: Ambusher
ambusher.description: Tactical stationary concealment, hunting stand mastery, and caller deception skills.

challenges.title: Patient Stand
challenges.description: Harvest 5 animals from any ground blind or elevated tree stand.

challenges.title: Call Response
challenges.description: Lure 10 animals within 50 yards using predator or ungulate mouth calls.

challenges.title: Downwind Ghost
challenges.description: Harvest 8 animals while remaining completely downwind without alerting them.

challenges.title: Decoy Ambush
challenges.description: Harvest 15 waterfowl or upland birds within active decoy zones.

challenges.title: Close Quarters
challenges.description: Harvest 5 Tier 5 or higher big game animals from under 30 yards while concealed.

challenges.title: Master of the Blind
challenges.description: Complete 20 clean vital hits without leaving a hunting stand during a single session.

naturalist.name: Naturalist
naturalist.description: Ecological preservation, need zone mapping, and selective culling stewardship.

challenges.title: Zone Cartographer
challenges.description: Discover and inspect 15 distinct drinking, feeding, or resting need zones.

challenges.title: Herd Balancer
challenges.description: Harvest 10 low-fitness adult animals (sub-50% fitness) to improve overall herd health.

challenges.title: Sanctuary Preserver
challenges.description: Clear 5 environmental tasks or pollution hazards near primary water sources.

challenges.title: Age Inspection
challenges.description: Spot and record 12 Mature stage animals across 3 different game reserves.

challenges.title: Selective Harvest
challenges.description: Harvest 8 mature animals in their final lifecycle year before natural despawn occurs.

challenges.title: 5-Star Breeder Steward
challenges.description: Identify and track 5 different 5-star genetic specimens without harvesting them prematurely.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Trail corridor analysis, binocular identification, and waypoint exploration.

challenges.title: Visual Survey
challenges.description: Spot and identify 25 unique animals through binoculars or rangefinder scopes.

challenges.title: Migration Pathfinder
challenges.description: Discover 6 seasonal migration corridors between summer and winter grazing areas.

challenges.title: Peak Elevation
challenges.description: Reach and tag 4 high-elevation scenic overlooks or fire towers.

challenges.title: Bedding Investigator
challenges.description: Locate 10 active bed clusters during midday resting schedules.

challenges.title: Territory Master
challenges.description: Uncover 80% or more of all map landmarks across 3 different reserves.

challenges.title: Silent Surveyor
challenges.description: Track 15 different herds across 500+ yards without causing a single spook warning.

sharpshooter.name: Sharpshooter
sharpshooter.description: Ballistic precision, extreme long-range marksmanship, and ethical vital hits.

challenges.title: Clean Vitals
challenges.description: Achieve 10 heart or double-lung hits resulting in instantaneous ethical drops.

challenges.title: Over The Horizon
challenges.description: Harvest 5 animals from a distance greater than 200 yards.

challenges.title: Sniper's Nest
challenges.description: Harvest 3 large game animals from 350+ yards with zero bullet deflection.

challenges.title: Energy Transfer
challenges.description: Harvest 8 animals using the exact recommended kinetic energy caliber rating.

challenges.title: Heart Specialist
challenges.description: Deliver 5 precise direct heart punctures on Tier 4 or higher game.

challenges.title: The 500-Yard Milestone
challenges.description: Harvest any big game animal from 500 yards or beyond with a single round.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.description: Silent movement, low-crouch tracking, and close-quarters ambush approaches.

challenges.title: Footprint Tracker
challenges.description: Inspect and follow 20 consecutive fresh animal tracks to their source.

challenges.title: Ghost in the Grass
challenges.description: Travel 500 yards in prone or low-crouch posture without breaking stealth.

challenges.title: Point Blank Approach
challenges.description: Stalk within 25 yards of an unaware animal in open or semi-open terrain.

challenges.title: Blood Trail Hound
challenges.description: Recover 10 wounded animals by tracking blood trails under 30 yards in total length.

challenges.title: Apex Stalker
challenges.description: Stalk and harvest 4 apex predators (Bear, Wolf, or Cougar) from under 40 yards.

challenges.title: Shadow of the Wilderness
challenges.description: Harvest 10 animals while remaining crouched or prone without ever standing upright.
